What Sama sells

  • Data annotation: A dedicated workforce labels images and video, as well as 3D data.
  • Data validation: Human review and correction of model predictions.
  • Model evaluation: Human evaluation of factual accuracy and instruction following.
  • Professional services
  • Sama Assure: A quality guarantee for delivered data.
  • Sama Hub: A shared workspace for data projects.
